_note: Policy data for scripts/ci/check_workflows.py. `actions`: the ONLY third-party action repositories a workflow may use, each with the release tag and the commit SHA it pointed to when read from the public GitHub API on 17 November 2026 (GitHub-owned actions only). Every `uses:` in every workflow must be exactly one of these repository/SHA pairs (a different 40-hex SHA is a failure, not a pass). Re-verify when applying: a tag can move, a SHA cannot. A Dependabot update to an action therefore also needs this file updated in the same pull request, reviewed by the owner (the file is CODEOWNED). `actions/checkout` is deliberately absent: jobs use the access-safe checkout step instead (scripts/ci/safe_checkout.sh). `no_checkout_jobs`: jobs that never read repository files and so have no checkout step.
_checkout_control_env_note: Environment variable names (case-insensitive, `*` wildcard) that no workflow-level or job-level `env:` may define, because they would steer the access-safe checkout: the remote and the revision (REMOTE_URL, CHECKOUT_SHA, ATHENA_CHECKOUT_*; authenticated operation takes both from the job context only), credentials (GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_*), git configuration (GIT_*, HOME, USERPROFILE, XDG_*), and the shell and loader (BASH_ENV, ENV, SHELLOPTS, BASHOPTS, PS4, BASH_XTRACEFD, PATH, LD_*) or a proxy (*_PROXY). A job may not use `container:` either. scripts/ci/safe_checkout.sh refuses the overrides and drops inherited GIT_* itself; this list makes the same mistake visible in review before the workflow runs.
